== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Takeel-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.100. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-takeel.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese describes each player drawing one destiny during a battle; the English specifically says one battle destiny. The Japanese lore calls Takeel down-on-his-luck and a traitor, while the English calls him burned-out and a double-crosser. No Credits field is printed.
